headline: India Launches New Bengaluru To Madgaon Vande Bharat Express Train
seoTitle: New Bengaluru to Madgaon Vande Bharat Express
metaDescription: Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw launch the Bengaluru to Madgaon Vande Bharat Express, the longest such service.
aiSummaryBullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw officially inaugurated the new Vande Bharat Express service.
The train connects Bengaluru, Mangaluru, and Madgaon, operating as part of the nationwide railway network expansion.
This new service is currently identified as the longest-duration Vande Bharat route among the 82 existing services in India.
aiContextParagraph: The Indian railway network has expanded its high-speed infrastructure with the introduction of a new Vande Bharat Express train connecting Bengaluru, Mangaluru, and Madgaon. The inauguration ceremony took place on November 13, 2026, with Prime Minister Narendra Modi leading the event from Bengaluru and Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw presiding at Mangaluru Junction. This addition is significant as it marks the longest travel duration among all 82 Vande Bharat services currently operating across the country. The route is designed to enhance connectivity between these major urban and coastal hubs, providing commuters with updated travel options. Details regarding the specific timings, operational schedules, and fare structures for the new route have been released to the public as the service commences its operations today.
whyItIsViral: The event has generated significant public interest, reflected in a high search signal score, due to the expansion of a major national rail project.
